protocol:
1. Open a QSP pipette-tip box and set up disposable pipette tips beside the horizontal gel electrophoresis apparatus.

2. Place the gel slab with wells into the horizontal electrophoresis chamber containing clear running liquid, orienting the wells near the electrode end of the chamber.

3. Fit a disposable tip onto a LabServ 0.5–10 µL micropipette and aspirate purple sample solution from a microcentrifuge tube held in a tube rack.

4. Load the purple sample solution into the first well of the gel using the 0.5–10 µL micropipette.

5. Discard the used pipette tip into the red waste container.

6. Fit a new disposable tip onto the 0.5–10 µL micropipette and aspirate purple sample solution from another labeled microcentrifuge tube in the rack.

7. Load the second purple sample solution into a separate gel well.

8. Discard the used pipette tip into the red waste container.

9. Fit a new disposable tip onto the 0.5–10 µL micropipette and aspirate purple sample solution from an additional microcentrifuge tube.

10. Load the additional purple sample solution into another gel well.

11. Discard the used pipette tip into the red waste container.

12. Place the clear lid onto the electrophoresis chamber and connect the red and black electrode leads to the chamber terminals and the power supply.

13. Start the electrophoresis run on the power supply; the display changes from “End” to an active run display.
